{{Quote|I'm Ladra. Once the personal assassin of a Sith Lord, I am now the serene protector of the Master and his students. I contemplate Revan's teachings as I execute intruders and heretics. But I also guide initiates and help determine their trials.|Ladra|<ref name="TOR:TMoR" />}}
'''Ladra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Order of Revan|Revanite]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She resided in the [[Revanite compound]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Once the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] and personal [[Sith assassin/Legends|assassin]] of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Grathan]], she then served [[Tari Darkspanner|The Master]] and her students holding the title of Serene Protector of the Order of Revan. She asked a new cult member to recover from [[Lord Grathan's estate]] an object that had been lost for a very long time, [[Revan's mask]].<ref name="TOR:TMoR" />
